newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL- Stocks quiet after pre-close rally.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL- Stocks quiet after pre-close rally.

text.p: Trading was quiet in the after market Friday, following a day in which the Dow was off 104 in the late morning before crawling back to 8,194, down 29 points.
"There was a lot of economic news in the day, but it pretty much traded through and now it's quiet," one dealer said.
Bids for shares of Tyco International, which announced a two-for-one stock split, rose to 81, above a 80-3/4 close, but dealers said there were no trades.
There was also some movement in technology stocks as Intel traded higher at 93-13/16, above its 93-11/16 close and 3Com traded at 54-1/8, down from a 54-5/16 close.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 68,300, compared with 8,400 Thursday and session two had volume of 2.0 million, compared to nearly 2.3 million Thursday.
